value.rationale: Profile gradient bimodality is an operationally meaningful interpretive feature in coastal wells. The sharp 1.7776 intrinsic-width threshold proves that one oscillating interface can generate a misleading two-gradient time-average while leaving the midpoint unchanged; the result supplies an exact benchmark for distinguishing averaging artifacts from multiple physical mixing zones. Field application remains conditional on calibrated front dynamics and sampling coverage.
